name: Swarm of Flies lets Bloodbolt refresh Taldaram's Torment (#2334)
contract: Swarm of Flies 704646 applies aura 42 (proc trigger spell) on Spread Taldarams 704647 (SPELL_EFFECT_ASCENSION_REFRESH_AURA on Taldaram's Torment 800772 and Blood Parasites 800988), but Spell.dbc gives it ProcFlags 0 and no spell_proc row existed, so it never procced. With a spell_proc row restricted to Bloodbolt (SpellFamilyMask1 131072), casting Bloodbolt should refresh Taldaram's Torment's remaining duration back up. Taldaram's Torment is cast as 800772 itself: SPELL_EFFECT_ASCENSION_REFRESH_AURA (Spell::EffectAscensionRefreshAura) looks up the target's aura by the effect's hardcoded MiscValue, so the DoT must be exactly spell 800772 regardless of caster level - confirmed obtainable and functional at level 80 (this scenario's own first assertion passes). Bloodbolt is cast as rank 578305: a level-80 character owns only that rank of its module progression chain (578304 is granted only up to level 52); casting 578304 gets no server response and zero damage, so the family-mask-matched proc never sees a damage event.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
